<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { cn } from "../../../lib/utils";
import { SPRING_PRESS } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ href?: string; variant?: "primary" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "outline"; size?: "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "icon"; pressScale?: number }>(), { variant: "primary", size: "md", pressScale: 0.93 });
const reduced = useReducedMotion();
const color = computed(() => ({ primary: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90", secondary: "border border-border bg-card text-foreground hover:border-border", ghost: "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/60", outline: "border border-border bg-transparent text-foreground hover:bg-muted/60" })[props.variant]);
const geometry = computed(() => ({ sm: "h-8 px-3 text-xs gap-1.5 rounded-full", md: "h-10 px-5 text-sm gap-2 rounded-full", lg: "h-12 px-6 text-base gap-2 rounded-full", icon: "h-8 w-8 rounded-lg" })[props.size]);
</script>
<template>
  <motion.a :href="href" :while-press="reduced ? undefined : { scale: pressScale }" :while-hover="reduced ? undefined : { scale: 1.02 }"
    :transition="SPRING_PRESS" :class="cn('inline-flex items-center justify-center font-medium select-none transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2', color, geometry, $attrs.class)"><slot /></motion.a>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, onBeforeUnmount, ref, watch } from "vue";
import { motion, useMotionValue, useSpring } from "motion-v";
import { SPRING_MOUSE } from "../../../lib/ease";
import { resolveElement, useMediaQuery, useReducedMotion } from "../../../lib/composables";
const props = withDefaults(defineProps<{ strength?: number }>(), { strength: 0.35 });
const element = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null), reduced = useReducedMotion();
const hover = useMediaQuery("(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)");
const enabled = computed(() => hover.value && !reduced.value);

const springX = useSpring(x, SPRING_MOUSE), springY = useSpring(y, SPRING_MOUSE);
function reset() { x.set(0); y.set(0); }
function track(event: MouseEvent) {
  if (!enabled.value || !element.value) return;
  const bounds = element.value.getBoundingClientRect();
  x.set(props.strength * (event.clientX - bounds.left - bounds.width / 2));
  y.set(props.strength * (event.clientY - bounds.top - bounds.height / 2));
}
watch(enabled, active => { if (!active) { reset(); springX.jump(0); springY.jump(0); } });

defineExpose({ x, y });
</script>
<template><motion.div :ref="node => element = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(node)" @mousemove="track" @mouseleave="reset"
  :style="{ x: springX, y: springY }" class="inline-block"><slot /></motion.div></template>

<script setup lang="ts">

<script setup lang="ts">
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
import {
  computed,
  nextTick,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onMounted,
  ref,
  watch,
  type Ref,
} from "vue";

import { EASE_OUT } from "../../../lib/ease";

  defineProps<{
    side?: "top" | "bottom";
    align?: "start" | "end";
    sideOffset?: number;
    radius?: number;

    onOpenAutoFocus?: (content: HTMLDivElement) => void;
    className?: string;
  }>(),

const mounted = ref(false);
const present = ref(state.open.value);

  get: () => resolveElement<HTMLElement>(panel.value),
  set: (value) => {
    panel.value = value;
  },

  state.anchor,
  measured,
  computed(() => mounted.value && state.open.value),

const progress = motionValue(0);
const fade = motionValue(state.reduce.value ? 0 : 1);
const focus = createMorphFocus(
  props,
  () => state.open.value && !!layout.value,
  state.takeFocusOnOpen,

  panel,
  (value) => {
    state.content.value = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(value);
  },
  { flush: "post" },

const placement = computed(() => {
  const box = layout.value;
  if (!box) return { left: 0, top: 0, side: props.side, available: 0 };
  const gutter = 12;
  const free = {
    bottom: Math.max(
      0,
      window.innerHeight -
        box.trigger.top -
        box.trigger.height -
        props.sideOffset -
        gutter,
    ),
    top: Math.max(0, box.trigger.top - props.sideOffset - gutter),
  };
  const alternative = props.side === "top" ? "bottom" : "top";
  const side =
    box.content.height > free[props.side] &&
    free[alternative] > free[props.side]
      ? alternative
      : props.side;
  const preferred =
    box.trigger.left +
    (props.align === "end" ? box.trigger.width - box.content.width : 0);
  return {
    left: Math.max(
      gutter,
      Math.min(preferred, window.innerWidth - box.content.width - gutter),

    top:
      side === "bottom"

    progress.jump(1);
    animation = animate(fade, opened ? 1 : 0, {
      duration: 0.12,
      onComplete: done,

    animation = animate(progress, opened ? 1 : 0, {

      onComplete: done,

  state.open,
  async (opened) => {
    focus.reset();
    ++revision;
    if (opened) {
      layout.value = null;
      progress.jump(0);
      fade.jump(state.reduce.value ? 0 : 1);
      present.value = true;
      await nextTick();
    }
    run();
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);

  () => !!layout.value,
  (ready) => {
    if (ready) run();
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);

  mounted.value = true;
  present.value = state.open.value;
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  disposed = true;
  ++revision;
  animation?.stop();
  progress.destroy();
  fade.destroy();
  state.content.value = null;
});
</script>
<template>
  <Teleport v-if="mounted" to="body"
    ><motion.div
      v-if="present"
      data-morph-popover-portal=""
      :inert="!state.open.value"
      :style="{
        left: placement.left + 'px',
        top: placement.top + 'px',
        opacity: state.reduce.value ? fade : opacity,
        pointerEvents: state.open.value ? 'auto' : 'none',
        visibility: layout ? 'visible' : 'hidden',
      }"
      :class="[
        'fixed z-[9999]',
        shadow
          ? '[filter:drop-shadow(0_10px_18px_rgba(0,0,0,0.14))]'
          : undefined,
      ]"
      ><motion.div
        ref="panel"
        v-bind="$attrs"
        :id="state.contentId"
        role="dialog"
        :aria-labelledby="state.triggerId"
        tabindex="-1"
        :style="{
          clipPath: state.reduce.value ? undefined : clipPath,
          borderRadius: props.radius + 'px',
          maxHeight: layout ? placement.available + 'px' : undefined,
          overflowX: 'hidden',
          overflowY: 'auto',
        }"
        :class="
          cn(
            'overflow-hidden border border-border bg-background outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-inset focus-visible:ring-ring',
            $attrs.class as string,
            className,
          )
        "
        ><slot /></motion.div></motion.div

</template>

<script lang="ts">
import PopoverTrigger from "./PopoverTrigger.vue";
export default PopoverTrigger;
</script>

<script lang="ts">
import {
  Comment,
  Fragment,
  Text,
  cloneVNode,
  defineComponent,
  h,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  type VNode,
} from "vue";
import { resolveElement } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { usePopover } from "./context";

  return nodes.flatMap((node) =>
    node.type === Fragment
      ? flatten(node.children as VNode[])

        ? []
        : [node],
  );
}
export default defineComponent({
  name: "PopoverTrigger",
  inheritAttrs: false,
  setup(_, { attrs, slots }) {
    const state = usePopover();
    let keyboard = false;
    let contact: { kind: string; opened: boolean } | undefined;
    onBeforeUnmount(() => {
      state.trigger.value = null;
    });
    const click = (event: MouseEvent) => {
      if (event.defaultPrevented) return;
      if (state.kind === "morph") {
        state.armFocusOnOpen(
          !state.open.value && keyboard && event.detail === 0,
        );
        keyboard = false;
        state.toggle();
      } else if (state.p.trigger !== "hover") state.toggle();
      else {
        const gesture = contact;
        contact = undefined;
        if (gesture && gesture.kind !== "mouse") state.setOpen(!gesture.opened);
      }
    };
    return () => {
      const nodes = flatten(slots.default?.() ?? []);
      const child =
        nodes.length === 1 && nodes[0]!.type !== Text
          ? nodes[0]!
          : h(
              "button",
              {
                type: "button",
                class:
                  "inline-flex items-center rounded-full border border-border bg-background px-4 py-2 text-sm",
              },
              nodes,
            );
      return cloneVNode(
        child,
        {
          ...attrs,
          ref: (node: unknown) => {
            state.trigger.value = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(node);
          },
          id: state.triggerId,
          "aria-haspopup": "dialog",
          "aria-expanded": state.open.value,
          "aria-controls": state.open.value ? state.contentId : undefined,
          "data-state": state.open.value ? "open" : "closed",
          class: [
            attrs.class,
            state.kind === "goo" ? "relative z-0" : undefined,
          ],
          onPointerdown: (event: PointerEvent) => {
            keyboard = false;
            contact = { kind: event.pointerType, opened: state.open.value };
          },
          onPointercancel: () => {
            contact = undefined;
          },
          onKeydown: (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
            contact = undefined;
            keyboard = event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ";
          },
          onFocus: (event: FocusEvent) => {
            if (
              !event.defaultPrevented &&
              state.kind === "goo" &&
              state.p.trigger === "hover"

              state.openHover();
          },
          onBlur: (event: FocusEvent) => {
            if (
              !event.defaultPrevented &&
              state.kind === "goo" &&
              state.p.trigger === "hover"

              state.scheduleClose();
          },
          onClick: click,
        },
        true,
      );
    };
  },

</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
import { computed } from "vue";
import { motion, AnimatePresence } from "motion-v";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-vue-next";
import { MORPH, ROW, useSelect } from "./context";
import SelectRegistrar from "./SelectRegistrar.vue";
defineProps<{ className?: string }>();
const state = useSelect();
const list = state.list;
const label = computed(() => state.labelFor(state.value.value));
const variants = computed(() =>
  state.reduce.value
    ? undefined
    : {
        hidden: {},
        show: { transition: { staggerChildren: 0.035, delayChildren: 0.08 } },
      },
);

  if (event.key === "Tab") {
    event.preventDefault();
    state.close();
  } else state.keydown(event);
}
</script>
<template>
  <SelectRegistrar><slot /></SelectRegistrar
  ><AnimatePresence :initial="false" mode="popLayout"
    ><motion.div
      v-if="state.open.value"
      key="panel"
      v-bind="$attrs"
      :layout-id="state.layoutId"
      :transition="state.reduce.value ? { duration: 0 } : MORPH"
      :style="{ borderRadius: '12px' }"
      :class="[
        'absolute inset-x-0 top-0 z-30 overflow-hidden border border-border bg-background shadow-lg',
        className,
      ]"
      ><motion.button
        type="button"
        :id="state.headerId"
        layout="position"
        aria-haspopup="listbox"
        aria-expanded="true"
        :aria-controls="state.listId"
        @click="state.close"
        :class="[ROW, 'outline-none']"
        ><span
          class="min-w-0 truncate"
          :class="label ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground'"
          >{{ label ?? state.placeholder.value }}</span
        ><motion.span
          aria-hidden="true"
          :animate="{ rotate: 180 }"
          :transition="state.reduce.value ? { duration: 0 } : MORPH"
          class="text-muted-foreground"
          ><ChevronDown class="h-4 w-4" /></motion.span
      ></motion.button>
      <div class="h-px bg-border" />
      <motion.ul
        ref="list"
        :id="state.listId"
        role="listbox"
        :aria-labelledby="state.headerId"
        initial="hidden"
        animate="show"
        :variants="variants"
        @keydown="key"
        class="p-1"
        ><slot /></motion.ul></motion.div
  ></AnimatePresence>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import SelectItem from "./SelectItem.vue";
const props = defineProps<{
  value: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}>();
</script>
<template>
  <SelectItem v-bind="props"><slot /></SelectItem>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, watch } from "vue";
import { useSelect } from "./context";
const props = defineProps<{ placeholder?: string; className?: string }>();
const state = useSelect();
const label = computed(() => state.labelFor(state.value.value));
watch(
  () => props.placeholder,
  (value) => {
    if (value) state.placeholder.value = value;
  },
  { immediate: true },
);
</script>
<template>
  <span
    :class="[label ? 'text-foreground' : 'text-muted-foreground', className]"
    >{{ label ?? placeholder ?? "Select" }}</span
  >
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { nextTick, onBeforeUnmount, onMounted, ref, watch } from "vue";
import { motion, useTransform } from "motion-v";
import { resolveElement } from "../../../lib/composables";
import { useSelect } from "./context";
import { unfoldGeometry } from "./unfold";
defineProps<{ className?: string }>();
const state = useSelect();
const panel = state.list;
const height = ref(0);
const exiting = ref(false);
let disposed = false;
let measureRevision = 0;
let observer: ResizeObserver | undefined;
let unsubscribe: (() => void) | undefined;

  const revision = ++measureRevision;
  await nextTick();
  if (disposed || revision !== measureRevision) return;
  const element = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(panel.value);
  if (!element) return;
  height.value = element.offsetHeight;
  const trigger = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(state.trigger.value);
  if (state.open.value && trigger) {
    const rect = trigger.getBoundingClientRect();
    const room = window.innerHeight - rect.bottom;
    state.placement.value =
      room < height.value + 16 && rect.top > room ? "top" : "bottom";
  }

watch(
  state.open,
  (open, previous) => {
    if (!open && previous) exiting.value = true;
    if (open) void measure();
  },
  { flush: "post" },
);

  void measure();
  const node = resolveElement<HTMLElement>(panel.value);
  if (node && typeof ResizeObserver !== "undefined") {
    observer = new ResizeObserver(() => void measure());
    observer.observe(node);
  }
  unsubscribe = state.progress.on("animationComplete", () => {
    if (state.progress.get() === 0) exiting.value = false;
  });

});

  disposed = true;
  ++measureRevision;
  observer?.disconnect();
  unsubscribe?.();
  window.removeEventListener("resize", measure);
});
const geometry = () =>
  unfoldGeometry(
    state.progress.get(),
    height.value,
    state.placement.value === "top",
    state.reduce.value,
  );
const y = useTransform(() => geometry().y);
const borderRadius = useTransform(() => geometry().radius);
const clipPath = useTransform(() => geometry().clip);
const opacity = useTransform(() => geometry().opacity);

  if (event.key === "Tab") state.close();
  else state.keydown(event);
}
</script>
<template>
  <motion.div
    ref="panel"
    :id="state.listId"
    role="listbox"
    :aria-labelledby="state.triggerId"
    :aria-hidden="!state.open.value"
    :inert="!state.open.value"
    @keydown="keydown"
    :style="{
      visibility: state.open.value || exiting ? 'visible' : 'hidden',
      maxHeight: state.open.value || exiting ? undefined : 0,
      borderWidth: state.open.value || exiting ? undefined : 0,
      y,
      clipPath,
      borderRadius,
      opacity,
      pointerEvents: state.open.value ? 'auto' : 'none',
      marginTop: state.placement.value === 'top' ? '0px' : '8px',
      marginBottom: state.placement.value === 'top' ? '8px' : '0px',
    }"
    :class="[
      'absolute inset-x-0 z-20 overflow-hidden border border-border bg-background shadow-lg',
      state.placement.value === 'top' ? 'bottom-full' : 'top-full',
      className,
    ]"
    ><motion.div
      :initial="false"
      :animate="state.open.value ? 'show' : 'hidden'"
      class="p-1"
      ><slot /></motion.div
  ></motion.div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
import {
  computed,
  inject,
  onBeforeUnmount,
  onMounted,
  onUpdated,
  ref,
} from "vue";
import { motion } from "motion-v";
import { Check } from "lucide-vue-next";
import { useSelect, registrarKey, ITEM_VARIANTS, MORPH_ITEM } from "./context";

  defineProps<{
    value: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    label?: string;
    className?: string;
  }>(),
  { disabled: false },
);
const state = useSelect();
const hidden = inject(registrarKey, false);
const element = ref<HTMLElement | null>(null);
const token = Symbol("select-option-instance");

  if (registered !== undefined && registered !== props.value)
    state.unregister(registered, token);

    props.value,
    props.label ?? element.value?.textContent?.trim() ?? props.value,
    props.disabled,

onBeforeUnmount(() => {
  if (registered !== undefined) state.unregister(registered, token);

  state.reduce.value ? undefined : state.morph ? MORPH_ITEM : ITEM_VARIANTS,
);
</script>
<template>
  <span v-if="hidden" ref="element" hidden
    ><slot>{{ label ?? value }}</slot></span
  ><motion.div
    v-else
    :role="state.morph ? 'none' : undefined"
    :variants="variants"
    ><button
      ref="element"
      v-bind="$attrs"
      type="button"
      role="option"
      :aria-selected="selected"
      :disabled="disabled"
      :tabindex="state.activeId.value === value ? 0 : -1"
      :data-listbox-id="value"
      @click="state.select(value)"
      :class="[
        'flex w-full items-center justify-between gap-2 rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 text-left text-sm outline-none transition-colors',
        selected
          ? 'bg-muted text-foreground'
          : 'text-muted-foreground hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground focus-visible:bg-muted',
        'disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50',
        className,
      ]"
    >
      <slot>{{ label ?? value }}</slot
      ><Check v-if="selected" class="h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" :stroke-width="2.5" /></button
  ></motion.div>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { h, mergeProps, provide, renderSlot, useAttrs } from "vue";
import { registrarKey } from "./context";
defineOptions({ inheritAttrs: false });
const slots = defineSlots<{ default?(props: {}): any }>();
const attrs = useAttrs();
provide(registrarKey, true);
// Registration descendants stay mounted inside this injection boundary.
const RenderFrame = () =>
  h("div", mergeProps({ hidden: true }, attrs), [renderSlot(slots, "default")]);
</script>
<template><RenderFrame /></template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { motion, useTransform } from "motion-v";
import { ChevronDown } from "lucide-vue-next";
import { useSelect } from "./context";
defineProps<{ className?: string }>();
const state = useSelect();
const trigger = state.trigger;
const nearRadius = useTransform(
  state.progress,
  [0, 0.2, 0.4, 1],
  ["12px", "0px", "0px", "12px"],
);
const rotate = useTransform(
  () =>
    (state.reduce.value
      ? Number(state.open.value)
      : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, state.progress.get()))) * 180,
);
function openWithArrow(event: KeyboardEvent) {
  if (
    event.defaultPrevented ||
    state.disabled.value ||
    state.open.value ||
    !["ArrowDown", "ArrowUp"].includes(event.key)
  )
    return;
  event.preventDefault();
  state.open.value = true;
}
</script>
<template>
  <motion.button
    ref="trigger"
    type="button"
    data-trigger
    :id="state.triggerId"
    :disabled="state.disabled.value"
    aria-haspopup="listbox"
    :aria-expanded="state.open.value"
    :aria-controls="state.listId"
    @click="!state.disabled.value && (state.open.value = !state.open.value)"
    @keydown="openWithArrow"
    :style="{
      borderTopLeftRadius:
        state.reduce.value || state.placement.value !== 'top'
          ? '12px'
          : nearRadius,
      borderTopRightRadius:
        state.reduce.value || state.placement.value !== 'top'
          ? '12px'
          : nearRadius,
      borderBottomLeftRadius:
        state.reduce.value || state.placement.value === 'top'
          ? '12px'
          : nearRadius,
      borderBottomRightRadius:

import { useSelect } from "./context";
